cursor.note: PROVEME — the prediction made before the build held exactly: `cairnmap --gate` dropped from 21 findings to 6, and the 6 are name-for-name the ones the ticket put out of bounds (/ruled chartered-but-not-installed, five bin/cmd entries no charter's invoke names). 20/20 teeth green twice; edges 9/9 twice. skill_roster() is now skill_membership(), deriving from the node class's own `members_derived_by` rule and naming THREE faults, each exactly one red: no rule declared (the ABSENT-KEY shape `.get(key, [])` swallowed), `members_so_far` back, or a rule that stops naming skills/. `every_chartered_skill_is_on_the_roster` is RETIRED with a note naming its successor — under derivation it compares a set against a superset of itself, a green arithmetic guarantees, which Law 8 calls worse here than a red. Its falsifiable half survives as `every_skill_directory_carries_a_charter`. THREE BUGS THE VOYAGE UNCOVERED AND FIXED (bounds ruling 2026-09-09): (1) the proof's lane floor was `len(record) >= 8`, a count that cannot say WHICH lane went missing — now the lanes are named, so retiring one is an edit to that list; (2) TEETH was collected at import time, so a tooth appended at the end of the file never ran and the file printed a confident 19/19 over it — now collected at call time; (3) the WATCHME probe's first reading counted the gate's ABSOLUTE red total and fired at 7, six of which were the corpus's standing out-of-bounds findings — rewritten to read the DELTA a substituted starved node class adds, which is the only attributable number.

window.note: BUILDME — cairnmap's two skill-roster lanes read `members_so_far`, a key the corpus deliberately retired on 2026-08-28 in favour of `members_derived_by`. `.get(key, [])` on an ABSENT key returns [] without raising, so the unreadable-roster guard never fires and one missing roster becomes fifteen findings — one per chartered skill — instead of the single fault the charter demands. The build replaces skill_roster() with a membership reader that consults the derivation rule (absent rule, a returning `members_so_far`, or a rule not naming skills/ are each ONE red), retires `every_chartered_skill_is_on_the_roster` with a note naming its successor (under derivation it is a tautology — a green that cannot go red, Law 8), keeps `every_roster_entry_carries_a_charter` as `every_skill_directory_carries_a_charter` because it stays genuinely falsifiable, adds the tooth for the ABSENT-KEY shape the existing corrupt-file tooth never covered, moves the fixtures in cairnmap's and edges' proofs off the retired key, moves the charter's falsifier clauses 3 and 12 off it, and arms the WATCHME probe. The load-bearing prediction, made before the build: the gate drops from 21 findings to exactly 6.
